title: Purple sea urchin population index, California's North Coast

source.name: North Coast kelp ecosystem urchin surveys
source.publisher: California Department of Fish and Wildlife (Reef Check California survey data)

notes: With their main predator gone after the 2013 sea-star wasting outbreak, purple urchin numbers along California's North Coast increased by more than 10,000% -- shown here as an index where the pre-2014 population equals 100.
